hook.zh: 下班前十分钟，经理让你今晚留下帮忙，而你早有安排。
hook.en: Ten minutes before you leave, your manager asks you to stay late — again.

background.zh: 已经是这个月第三次。今晚你答应了去参加父亲的生日晚餐。经理 Michael 走过来，语气客气但带着「你不会拒绝吧」的预期，说客户明早要看方案，需要你今晚改完。团队里新同事 Lily 就坐在旁边。
background.en: It's the third time this month. Tonight you promised to be at your father's birthday dinner. Michael, your manager, walks over, polite but clearly expecting a yes: the client needs the deck by tomorrow morning. Lily, a new teammate, sits within earshot.

personality.zh: 客气但强势，习惯用「大家都在拼」施压；对于有替代方案的拒绝能接受。
personality.en: Courteous but pushy; leans on 'everyone's pulling their weight'; accepts a no that comes with an alternative.

stance.zh: 明早前必须交付，谁做无所谓。
stance.en: The deck must ship by morning; who does it doesn't matter.

hidden.zh: 其实客户只要先看前三页。
hidden.en: The client really only needs the first three slides tomorrow.

objectives.zh: 清楚说「今晚不行」，不过度解释也不道歉三次。
objectives.en: Say a clear no for tonight without over-explaining or triple apologizing.

objectives.zh: 提出一个真正可行的替代方案。
弄清楚客户明早真正需要什么。
objectives.en: Find out what the client actually needs tomorrow.

success.zh: Michael 接受方案，你今晚按时离开。
success.en: Michael accepts the plan and you leave on time.

failure.zh: 你答应留下，或对话变得对立。
failure.en: You agree to stay, or the exchange turns adversarial.

text.zh: 嘿，还没走吧？客户明早九点要看方案，今晚得把第三部分重做一下。你最熟，帮我盯一下？
text.en: Hey, still here? The client wants the deck at nine tomorrow and section three needs a redo. You know it best — can you stay on it tonight?

messages.text: 嘿，还没走吧？客户明早九点要看方案，今晚得把第三部分重做一下。你最熟，帮我盯一下？
今晚是父亲生日，我不能留下；可以先说清明早真正要交哪部分。
